name: Amdiglurax
summary: Amdiglurax (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name), also known by its former developmental code names ALTO-100 and NSI-189 (short for "NeuralStem Inc.

pharmacology.text: Amdiglurax (INN), also known by its former developmental code names ALTO-100 and NSI-189 (short for "NeuralStem Inc. 189"), is a drug described as a hippocampal neurogenesis stimulant and indirect brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) modulator which is under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD), bipolar depression, and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).
pharmacology.kind: Hippocampal neurogenesis/neuroplasticity stimulant; Indirect brain-derived neurotrophic factor modulator

uses.text: Amdiglurax (INN), also known by its former developmental code names ALTO-100 and NSI-189 (short for "NeuralStem Inc. 189"), is a drug described as a hippocampal neurogenesis stimulant and indirect brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) modulator which is under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD), bipolar depression, and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD).

summaryZh: NSI-189是一種由Neuralstem, Inc.開發的實驗性抗憂鬱藥，用於治療嚴重憂鬱疾患、認知障礙以及神經退行性疾病。相關研究由美國國防高等研究計劃署以及國立衛生研究院出資。NSI-189的效用在於使海馬迴增強的神經元新生以及使其體積增大，但NSI-189達成此效果的機理尚不明朗。

sideEffects.en: In trials the reported effects were mild and included headache, nausea and trouble sleeping. It has not been through large long-term studies, so its full safety profile is not known.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中回報的反應都較輕微，包括頭痛、噁心與睡眠困難。它尚未經過大型長期研究，因此完整的安全性資料並不清楚。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中回报的反应都较轻微，包括头痛、恶心与睡眠困难。它尚未经过大型长期研究，因此完整的安全性数据并不清楚。

fact.en: Its old code name NSI-189 stands for the company Neuralstem Inc. It drew attention because it appeared to encourage the growth of new nerve cells in the hippocampus, the brain's memory region.
fact.zh: 它的舊代號 NSI-189 來自 Neuralstem Inc. 公司。它之所以受到關注，是因為它似乎能促進大腦記憶區域海馬體中新神經細胞的生長。
fact.zhHans: 它的旧代号 NSI-189 来自 Neuralstem Inc. 公司。它之所以受到关注，是因为它似乎能促进大脑记忆区域海马体中新神经细胞的生长。
